sections.title: Launch readiness
sections.sql: select * from onboarding.launch_readiness order by target_on,name

sections.title: Outstanding customer work
sections.sql: select project,name,owner,due_on,overdue,blockers from onboarding.task_board where responsible='customer' and status!='done' order by due_on

sections.title: Effort and recent contact
sections.sql: select name,budget_hours,logged_hours,last_update from onboarding.project_health order by name

sections.title: Records needing review
sections.sql: select * from onboarding.privacy_review where finding is not null
